transcript.content: Hello, welcome to the clinic. What brings you in to see me today?

I guess… I’ve just stopped doing things that usually make me feel like myself. Photography walks, helping mentor the kids, even keeping my calendar straight—it all started feeling kind of flat and heavy. I wasn’t really starting anything anymore, so… I thought I should come in.
How long have you been feeling this way?
About… a year and a few months, I think. Maybe fifteen months. It started after someone in my family’s health and behavior changed, and I ended up handling more of the coordinating.
Do you still enjoy the activities you mentioned, like photography walks, or have you lost interest in them?

Yeah… I guess I still like the idea of them, but they don’t feel the same. Photography walks used to kind of reset me, and now they just feel… heavy. Same with mentoring, even keeping my calendar organized. I don’t really start those things anymore unless someone pushes me.
Do you still get pleasure from things that you used to enjoy?
Not really, no. I mean… I can remember enjoying them, like the photography walks or working with the kids, but lately it’s more like they feel flat. Heavy. I just don’t start them the way I used to.
Have you been having any thoughts about hurting yourself or wishing you were dead?
I… don’t really want to get into that. I’m not sure how to answer it cleanly.
Have you been feeling anxious or on edge lately?
I don’t know… maybe a little. I haven’t really been tracking it. I feel tense sometimes, but I’m not sure I’d call it anxious.
Have you been having any problems with your sleep?
Yeah… some nights. I’ll only sleep maybe two or three hours, then I’m up before dawn. And instead of feeling wiped out, I’ll feel like I should start answering emails or fixing appointment lists.
Have you been feeling guilty about anything lately?
Not really… I mean, nothing specific comes to mind. I don’t think I’ve been feeling guilty, at least not more than usual.
Do you find yourself pacing back and forth or feeling like you need to be in constant motion?

Yeah… not pacing exactly, maybe sometimes. It’s more like I can’t just sit there. I’ll start redoing work templates, organizing files, sending emails to relatives… trying to handle a bunch of things at once, like if I stop I’m missing something.
Have you lost any weight recently?
I haven’t really noticed. My clothes feel about the same, I think.
Do you feel like you're moving more slowly than you used to?
I don’t think so. I haven’t really noticed myself moving slower… maybe tired sometimes, but not slower exactly.
Have you had periods in the past where you felt really down or depressed for a couple of weeks at a time?
I don’t know… maybe, but I can’t really say it was a full couple of weeks. I’ve had low stretches, sure, but I don’t keep track like that.
Are there any activities that you still find pleasure or enjoyment in?

Not as much lately. Things I usually liked—going out for photography walks, helping mentor the kids, even just keeping my calendar organized—have felt kind of… flat. Heavy, I guess. I just don’t start them like I used to.
Have you ever had a period in your life where you felt depressed for several weeks or more?
I’m not really sure. I’ve had times where I felt pretty low, but “several weeks or more” is hard for me to say. I don’t really track it that closely.
Have you had any days in the past two weeks where you felt somewhat better, or has it been consistently feeling flat and heavy?

Mostly it’s been pretty consistently flat. I mean, maybe little moments are less bad, but the main thing is… the stuff that usually makes me feel like myself—photography walks, mentoring the kids, keeping my calendar clean—just feels heavy, and I haven’t really been starting any of it.
Have you had any significant changes in appetite recently?
I don’t think so. I mean, I haven’t really been paying close attention, but nothing major that I’ve noticed.
Have you had any days in the past month where you felt normal or close to your usual self?

Not really. There might’ve been a day here or there that was less heavy, but I haven’t felt much like my usual self. The things that normally help me feel like me—like photography walks or mentoring—just feel flat, and I haven’t been starting them.
Are there any activities that you still enjoy or look forward to?

Not really. Photography walks used to be something I’d look forward to, and mentoring the kids too… even just keeping my calendar organized. Lately it all just feels kind of flat and heavy, so I don’t really start any of it.
Are there any small things that still give you pleasure?

Maybe small things here and there, but… not much. The stuff that usually makes me feel like myself—photo walks, mentoring, even just keeping my calendar neat—it’s all felt kind of flat and heavy. I just haven’t been starting things.
Have you had any periods in the past two weeks where you felt so low that you couldn't get out of bed?
I don’t think so… I’ve had slow mornings, but I can usually get myself up eventually.
